source:
"...[url=https://vndb.org/c43557]Uluca[/url] is really stupid. Did you forget about me again?"

A tall young man with odd eyes and long hair who suddenly showed up in front of Rufen. He wears the Academy's uniform, but doesn't seem to be a student there.

He approached Rufen to "teach him how to make a contract," which Rufen knew nothing about. What is his purpose for being here...?

[Translate from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111116154459/http://senz.jp/chara/chara7.html]official website[/url]]
